name: Split View
description: iPad-style Split View: drag a window down by its title bar and over to the left or right edge, then pick a second window for the other side. Drag the divider between them to resize both, snapping to a third, a half or two thirds; drag it to an edge to go back to one window, or double-tap it to swap the two sides. Dragging down from a title bar always does this, so in a browser such as Brave you can't pull a tab down to open it in its own window; dragging tabs sideways still works.
